0–9s: Worker A runs while B, C and D fill the bounded queue. A FULL signal travels to the producer.
10–14s: The producer pauses with E waiting outside the full queue; the worker continues.
15.5–19s: Taking B frees a slot. The producer resumes and admits E.
21–26s: C leaves the queue and completes. D then leaves and is still running as the scene fades, with E waiting and three jobs completed. This is continued service, not completion of the whole batch.
